§6FEL (Free Electron Laser)§f

§aA 7x3x3 laser cannon that powers your SILEX machines. Don't stand in front of it.§f

The FEL is a pseudo-multiblock that produces laser wavelengths for the §bSILEX§f. It needs §e10.0 MHE§f to activate and a §bLaser Crystal§f as wavelength filter.

Crafted in the Assembly Factory (20s, 100HE/t): 1 Lithium-Ion Battery, 64 Dense Gold Wire, 12 Triple Steel Plate, 16 Plastic Bars, 4 Polarized Lens, 16 Capacitor, 4 Integrated Circuit Board.

Crystal options: §bCO2-Desh§f (Infrared, 75 kHE/s, burns you), §bBismuth§f (Visible, 225 kHE/s, blinds you), §bCMB-Schrabidate§f (UV, 675 kHE/s, burns you), §bSpark§f (Gamma, 2.03 MHE/s, ~400 RAD/s), §bDigamma§f (6.08 MHE/s, ~0.2 DRX/s).

§cWARNING:§f Place SILEX at least §e2§f blocks away or it melts. One FEL powers §e5§f SILEX units. Concrete stops the laser; glass lets it through!
